description: The bar chart illustrates the "Average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests" across various AI models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying model names with diagonally rotated labels. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Average score (temperature = 0.5)," using a linear scale that ranges from 60 to 90 with a tick label interval of 10. A legend in the upper left corner defines the bar colors: solid blue indicates a "Small model," while light blue corresponds to a legend entry with a grayed-out or redacted label. The chart features nine vertical bars, each annotated with its exact numerical value above the bar and capped with a black error bar. The bars are sorted in ascending order of their scores. The shortest bar is for "Llama-3.3 70B Instruct" (light blue) with a value of 66.4, followed by "Claude 3.5 Sonnet" (light blue, 74.8), "Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct" (solid blue, 77.4), "GPT 4o" (light blue, 77.9), "GPT 4o-mini" (solid blue, 78.2), "Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct" (light blue, 78.7), "Gemini Flash 1.5" (solid blue, 81.6), and "Gemini Pro 1.5" (light blue, 89.8). The tallest bar represents "phi-4" (solid blue) with a score of 91.8. Visually, the horizontal axis label for "phi-4" is emphasized in bold text.
